title: She was Murdered Twice
summary: At a corporate team building event, an entrepreneur was murdered
method: The victim was smothered by the killer, then in an attempt to cover up the murder, the killer came back and shot the victim. The idea was that they would find the true cause of death in the autopsy and if he admitted to shooting her, he would get a lesser sentence of attempted murder.
motive: The victim was about to discover that the killer was not actually her son but rather someone who met her son in jail and stole his identity because he saw an opportunity. The killer had fingerprints, which makes it impossible for him to be her son.
killer: An employee who was pretending to be the victim's son
